opening.text: I'm here because I have pain on the right side of my chest. I've also had a fever, chills, and a cough. Three days ago I had an open operation to take out my gallbladder, and the cut is below my right ribs. The fever, chills, and headache started three days after that operation. I should also mention that I smoke a pack of cigarettes a day, and I have for 17 years.
